title: Movie Theater
content: I was in the movie theater last night. I remember there being a bunch of rooms though. I couldn't look down the hallway but I saw a long corridor with rooms out of my peripheral. The theater was running but it was dingy and abandoned. The rows of seats seemed to go on forever. The odd bathrooms also made an appearance. Way to many stalls, some stalls had no doors, some were broken. One thing that stood out is there was a secret passage to something beneath the theater. Something lived down there, it was a massive shadow, the area reminded me of a boiler room. The mass took up an entire corner from floor to ceiling. Something screamed not to let it see me. I remember peeking around the corner then my vision was turned away from the image and I was suddenly woken up.
